sharedRules: Use a dedicated worktree per model task
Use @typescript/native for the TypeScript 7 npx tsc compiler and typescript only as the TypeScript 6 compiler-API alias
Never introduce TypeScript 5.x or lower in direct constraints or resolved compiler entries
Do not treat localStorage as authentication
Do not claim a check passed without current command evidence
Record changed files, tests, risks, and rollback steps
Use company agent and integration manifests as required authority boundaries
Run bounded E2E smoke by default; database-writing E2E requires E2E_ALLOW_DATABASE_WRITES=1
Human approval is required for authentication, tenant, data, and deployment changes
releaseBlockers: Derive tenant and role from the authenticated principal
Remove silent production in-memory write fallback
Pass authorization matrix and tenant-isolation tests
